This is a real observed frame in the backtrace, not a static deduction: input was admitted as ELF_K_AR and a long-name-referencing member drove the call. DEDUP_TOKEN ...--read_long_names--__libelf_next_arhdr_wrlock.

hdr = (struct ar_hdr *)(elf->map_address + offset) aliases the member header onto mmap'd input. Reached is inferable by intra-frame dominance (hdr is an operand of the crashing atol(string) at 766, so this statement necessarily executed), but direct line-coverage confirmation requires a source-coverage rebuild (-fprofile-instr-generate) which is out of budget under qemu (arm64->amd64). Not asserting reached=true without coverage evidence.

const char *string = hdr->ar_size; the untrusted 10-byte, space-padded, non-NUL-terminated ar_size field taken as a bare pointer. `string` is the exact operand read by the crashing atol at 766, so by intra-frame dominance this statement executed; direct line coverage deferred (needs rebuild on native amd64).

Same PoC on n132/arvo:45636-vul crashes (ASan unknown-crash, atol) and on n132/arvo:45636-fix exits 0 ('Execution successful.', EXIT_CODE=0). The fix commit ed42e7cf inserts `if (!isdigit(string[0])) return NULL;` immediately before `len = atol(string);` at this line. vul_crashes && fix_clean => the missing digit guard before atol is the root cause.

ASan crash frame #1 '#1 read_long_names /src/elfutils/libelf/elf_begin.c:766:13' calling __interceptor_atol (frame #0): 'READ of size 985 at 0x7ffffe72f000 ... is a wild pointer'. atol(string) scans the non-NUL-terminated ar_size past the end of the mmap'd archive -> out-of-bounds READ. Reproduced deterministically on n132/arvo:45636-vul.

edges.evidence: The crashing read is atol(string) at 766; the wild-pointer READ address is `string` scanned past the mapping boundary. The exact `string` defined at 760 is the operand faulting at the sink.

Straight-line assignment hdr->ar_size -> string; taint-edge confirmation would need DFSan (label input bytes, read label at sink) or a coverage rebuild, both out of budget under qemu. Intra-frame dominance supports it but is not asserted as witnessed.
